dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Oh right, do you remember when Verna mentioned a place called the Court of the First Edict, when we were back at Thunderclap Reef?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Paimon thinks it's somewhere over on Hiisi Island. If we've got some time to spare, why not go back and have a look?
